plain.li: [annals:growing] There are more names to remember now than at the start of the year, and more hands at the harvest.
[annals:peaceful] A year with few raids, and the walls had a year's rest along with the rest of us.
[annals:losses] We lost people this year, and I've tried to write them down as they were.
Whatever next year holds, the fields will need sowing and the roofs will need mending, and we'll do both.
[annals:violent] A hard year for raids, and every one of us still here has earned the next one.

warm.li: [annals:growing] Every new face this year was a stranger once, and none of them is now.

blunt.li: [annals:richer] More in the stores than last year, so let's not waste it.

cheerful.li: Another year in the book, and I've left the next page clean for better news.

gloomy.li: [annals:losses] I wrote this year's names slowly, because I didn't want to write them at all.

cold.li: [annals:peaceful] A quiet year means the next one may not be, so we should prepare.

plain.li: [firstyear] A year ago I didn't know anyone's name here, and now I know everyone's.
[firstyear] My first year here is done, and I wasn't sure I'd see it through.
Another year here, and I still stop to look at the view from the gate.
[old] I've lived a long time, and this place has been one of the better parts of it.
Another year here, and I'm still not used to the summers.
I've more friends here now than I ever had anywhere before.
Every year here I find something new to complain about, and every year I'm still here.
All things considered, it's been a decent year, and I'm in no hurry to leave.
Some of this year was hard, but I'm still glad I stayed.

cold.li: I've been here long enough that the newer ones come to me with their questions.
